units.rawText: Professor, here is the battle report from Rossum and the surrounding sectors. Please review it. Included within is the latest proposal for a unionized defense strategy, with plans to bolster the military strength of each sector.

units.rawText: Thank you, Hannah. But what might these other documents be?

spans.text: Thank you, Hannah. But what might these other documents be?

units.rawText: These are the records Turing kept from when you first arrived at Rossum, Professor. I heard you might need some assistance, so I brought them along.

units.rawText: Ah... don't worry about me, Professor. The Turing of the past will always be with me, but I will always remain in the present, never to look back... There's no need for concern.

units.rawText: You helped us solve both crises in Rossum. Without your help, there's no way I'd be standing here.

units.rawText: I extend my hand, softly ruffling Hannah's head.

units.rawText: Professor... You know I'm the administrator of the Rossum Sector. Please don't treat me like a kid anymore.

units.rawText: Sorry, seeing how much you've grown really made me...

spans.text: Sorry, seeing how much you've grown really made me...

units.rawText: Is that so? Umm... That was really comfortable, so I'll forgive you this time.
units.displayText: Is that so? Umm... That was really comfortable, so I'll forgive you this time.

spans.text: Is that so? Umm... That was really comfortable, so I'll forgive you this time.

units.rawText: Professor, while Rossum may not excel in battles, as an ally of the Oasis, please don't hesitate to reach out to us if you need anything. We will do everything in our power to support the Oasis.
